value.title: Reviewer handback: native send repairs shim body refusal

sections.name: body
sections.value:
The PR 243 correctness/proof handover is already in `2026-11-18-pr-243-cached-status-stale-answer-guard`; do not duplicate it.

Separate handback trap: `pij send --help` exposes native `--body`, but `pij send <seat> --body ...` refused with `unknown send flag --body`. The verified repair was `pij-rs send --to <seat> --body '<text>' --in-reply-to <message-id>`. Its accepted, durably queued receipt was `01a1ed38-ec25-7530-9d02-0512dc1252cd`. A writer's held FYI alone is not the requested actionable PM handback; verify the separate send receipt before reporting it sent.
